name: Rediet Solomon
title: DevOps, Cloud & AI Infrastructure Engineer
headline: DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 5+ years architecting, automating, and operating high-availability production systems across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments.
summary: DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 5+ years architecting, automating, and operating high-availability production systems across cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), on-premises virtualization (Proxmox/KVM, OLVM, Hyper-V), and edge environments. Specialized in CI/CD pipeline engineering, Kubernetes operations, Infrastructure as Code, and full-stack observability, with recent depth in AI-ready platforms: GPU inference infrastructure, SDN fabrics, and distributed telemetry. Proven record delivering end-to-end automation for enterprise ERP, banking, and AI/ML workloads, and resolving critical production issues across cloud, virtualization, networking, and application layers.
highlights: 14-stage Jenkins CI/CD pipeline for Odoo 18 with quality gates, Telegram approvals, and 87% faster deployments
GPU inference on NVIDIA T4/L4 and Jetson AGX Orin with YOLOv8, TensorRT, and real-time telemetry
Observability stacks with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, SigNoz, ClickHouse, and DCGM GPU metrics
SR-MPLS and SDN fabric design using ONOS, FRRouting, VXLAN, and Open vSwitch
24/7 infrastructure support for mission-critical USSD and digital banking platforms

bullets: Deployed GPU-based AI inference services (YOLOv8, TensorRT FP16/FP8) on NVIDIA T4, L4, and Jetson AGX Orin for real-time image processing across a 5-node hybrid cloud mesh (AWS, GCP, NYC edge).
Built an SR-MPLS traffic-engineered fabric with FRRouting, an OSPF underlay, and VXLAN overlays controlled by an ONOS OpenFlow SDN controller with full topology discovery.
Established end-to-end observability using Prometheus custom exporters, SigNoz, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana covering inference latency, DCGM GPU telemetry, and network performance KPIs.
Implemented edge-to-cloud inference workflows driven by DQN-based placement logic and LSTM time-series prediction for workload scheduling.
Created systemd persistence services for VXLAN tunnels and OVS bridges, resolving Jetson kernel MPLS limitations through OVS-only forwarding, with engineering documentation for operational handoff.
Contributed to a 28-claim utility patent (NTX-001-NP) covering distributed compute orchestration, closed-loop rerouting, and intent-based API architecture.

Lead DevOps and infrastructure operations for a multi-server Odoo 18 ERP ecosystem (Odoo, AI VM, PostgreSQL/HAProxy cluster, Traefik, SigNoz) serving the leading construction machinery dealer in Ethiopia.
Designed and implemented a 14-stage Jenkins CI/CD pipeline with automated quality gates, database backup, Telegram approval gates, and blue-green deployments, cutting deployment time by 87%.
Deployed OpenTelemetry Collectors with OTLP export and batch/retry policies to ship structured logs to SigNoz, and built Grafana dashboards and alerting for user activity and service health.

Built an AI-powered multilingual customer support chatbot on Ollama (Llama 3.1 8B) with NLLB-200 12-language translation, a FastAPI backend, a Telegram bot, and an embeddable JavaScript widget integrated with Odoo 18 Helpdesk.
Configured high-availability PostgreSQL with Patroni, administered MySQL/MariaDB instances, and orchestrated traffic delivery with Traefik, Nginx, HAProxy, and Cloudflare.

Automated resource provisioning across Linux and Proxmox VE hypervisors with Terraform and Bash, and maintained multi-environment container deployments using Docker Compose, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins.

Developed custom Odoo 18 modules (user manuals, service monitoring, Telegram user management) with RBAC and webhook architecture, and configured coturn TURN for WebRTC plus mailcow SMTP relay with SPF/DKIM, OPNsense NAT, and Cloudflare DNS.
Led root-cause analysis for production incidents across network, container, database, and system layers, increasing overall service availability.
Deploy and manage applications with Docker and Docker Compose across Linux-based production environments.
Administer containers, images, volumes, networks, and application configuration to keep services running reliably.
Manage PostgreSQL database backups and maintain infrastructure documentation in line with DevOps best practices.
Containerized core enterprise applications with Docker and Kubernetes to guarantee environment parity and scalable deployment.
Provided 24/7 infrastructure monitoring and deployment support for mission-critical banking services, including Wegagen Bank USSD/E-Banking, Hijra Bank E-Banking, and Siinqee Bank systems.
Deployed full-stack monitoring and centralized logging with Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, SigNoz, OpenTelemetry, and the ELK Stack, and partnered with development teams to improve release stability.
Administered Linux servers, database systems, and application environments, enforcing security policies, high-availability standards, and rapid production incident resolution.
Maintained virtualized environments and Linux servers to hold system stability and performance SLAs.
Managed pfSense firewalls, configured VLANs and VPN tunnels, and implemented network security rules.
Set up system monitoring with Zabbix and Grafana to support prompt incident resolution.
Supported corporate infrastructure including Proxmox, OLVM, Nginx, Apache, WildFly, HAProxy, Zimbra, Mailcow, and Exchange.
